# LLMReady

> An open-source AI compatibility auditor. Classify a site into one of six profiles, then validate /llms.txt, RFC 9309 robots.txt, static HTML signal-to-noise and profile-specific schema.org metadata.

## Product

- [Audit workspace](https://github.com/aiden/llm-seo-toolbox#readme): Classify a site, run the 20-check audit matrix and inspect line-level fixes.
- [Site classification](https://github.com/aiden/llm-seo-toolbox#site-classification): The six profiles and the signals behind them, with manual override.
- [Live specification checklist](https://github.com/aiden/llm-seo-toolbox#scoring-model): The checks the audit enforces, with pass conditions.
- [API](https://github.com/aiden/llm-seo-toolbox#api): `GET /api/audit?url=example.com` returns the full JSON report, including `classification`.

## Standards

- [llms.txt specification](https://llmstxt.org/): The manifest structure this project validates.
- [RFC 9309](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9309): Robots Exclusion Protocol.
- [schema.org](https://schema.org/): Structured data vocabularies used by the audit.

## Project

- [Source code](https://github.com/aiden/llm-seo-toolbox): GPL-3.0-only.
- [Deploy on Vercel](https://vercel.com/new/clone?repository-url=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Faiden%2Fllm-seo-toolbox): One-click deployment.
- [Buy me a coffee](https://www.buymeacoffee.com): Support the project.

## Optional

- [Issues](https://github.com/aiden/llm-seo-toolbox/issues): Report a bug or request a check.
- [Contributing](https://github.com/aiden/llm-seo-toolbox/blob/main/README.md#contributing): Run the full validation suite before opening a PR.
